**Bindings**
Create requires a digest-bound `ur10e.yield-fair-campaign-freeze-v1` export with SFC/DSFC/MSFC incumbents. A boolean `valid`/`complete` flag is not enough. The six cells, five arms, three settings, and 180-trial ceiling are copied from `report/yield-validation-reservation-v2/protocol.json`. Execution is `run_closed_loop(..., campaign_kind='holdout', record_fullstate=True, require_ur10e=True, timeline='full_cycle', full PERIOD)`. MSFC_IDENTITY runs actual method MSFC with frozen MSFC coefficients except `minimum_metric_eigenvalue=1`. SFC_RADIAL keeps method `SFC_RADIAL` and frozen SFC coefficients. Raw artifact methods are not relabeled. Prior `n0` comes from calibrated home approach + `Task.reference(0)` tangent axes into `estimator initial_inward_normal_base`. Each arm/cell/resolution has its own nominal. Base `.002/sub8`, controller `.001/sub4`, plant `.002/sub16`.

The evaluator reuses training full-state parsers, `cell_weight` / objective helpers, `summarize_trial`, and original `compare_pair`. It does not call or monkeypatch the three-method training evaluator. J uses onset 20 / scenario `parse_scenario` release / att onset 20, same scales, and final-cell clipping. Nominal bands and disturbed guards are flags only. Out-of-band complete pairs are kept and still refined. Failed/incomplete base pairs skip both refinements without retry.
